note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin
bash infra/deploy.sh rg-mglab-azure-02 swedencentral lab   # governance, what-if, workload, probe (about 10 minutes); the policy assignment needs about five minutes to apply
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv; $st = az storage account list -g rg-mglab-azure-02 --query "[0].id" -o tsv; $kv = az keyvault list -g rg-mglab-azure-02 --query "[0].id" -o tsv
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $me --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Storage Blob Data Reader' --scope $st -o none

az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $me --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Key Vault Secrets User' --scope $kv -o none   # so the 'refused' shot proves the network block, not missing permissions

screens.name: policy-deny
screens.note: If a request succeeds the assignment is not active yet: wait, delete the NSG it created, retry.

screens.name: what-if
commands: az group create --name rg-mglab-azure-02-whatif --location swedencentral --tags workload=contoso environment=lab --output none
az deployment group what-if --resource-group rg-mglab-azure-02-whatif --parameters infra/env/lab.bicepparam
mask: subscription ID in the scope lines
screens.note: Empty group, so every resource shows as Create.

screens.name: private-proof
screens.note: If /healthz says Unhealthy right after deployment, wait a few minutes and run again.

screens.name: resource-visualizer
steps: Open Resource visualizer in the left menu
Arrange so the web app, plan, VNet, two private endpoints, storage, key vault, DNS zones and workspace are all visible
Optional: open the web app, Health check blade showing /healthz
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu

teardown: bash infra/teardown.sh rg-mglab-azure-02   # deletes the group (policy assignments included) and purges the lab vault
az group exists --name rg-mglab-azure-02   # false when done
